title: Base URL
description: Where to send requests, on the server machine and elsewhere.

sections.title: Choosing the base URL
paragraphs: On the server machine, use http://localhost:4000, or the port you started Bureau with. From anywhere else, use the public URL configured in User Settings → Access, for example https://office.example.ts.net. All API routes live under /api.

sections.title: Conventions
paragraphs: Requests and responses are JSON. Errors return a JSON object with an error message. Timestamps are milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Unknown /api paths return 404 with {"error":"not_found"}.
